title: Linear Statistical Models
standfirst: The theory of linear regression — assumptions, diagnostics, inference and extensions.
instructor: Prof. Siva Athreya (International Centre for Theoretical Sciences - TIFR
resources_note: An IITM email may be required for some of the resources above; any other access request will be strictly rejected.

description_paragraphs: To introduce linear statistical models and their applications in estimation and testing. The course will illustrate concepts with specific examples, data sets and numerical exercises using statistical package R.
faculty: Prof. Siva Athreya (International Centre for Theoretical Sciences - TIFR, and Indian Statistical Institute, Bangalore Centre)

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Basic statistics; Introduction to R; Data visualization using ggplot2 and geoms.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Introduction to linear models; Residual analysis; Working with datasets in R.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Fundamentals of linear models; Parameter estimation problem; Theory of linear regression.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Classification of linear models; Least squares estimation; Normal equations; Matrix fundamentals.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Estimation of regression coefficients; Hypothesis testing and confidence intervals; Model evaluation (RSE, R²); Implementation in R.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Gauss-Markov theorem; BLUE (best linear unbiased estimator); Variance analysis; Normality assumptions.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Applications of Gauss-Markov theorem; Multiple regression visualization; Real data analysis and simulations in R.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Hypothesis testing in regression; Testing linear hypotheses; ANOVA concepts; Least squares theory extensions.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: One-way and two-way classification models; ANOVA testing; Model evaluation in general cases.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Statistical testing in R; t-tests for simple and multiple regression; One-way ANOVA implementation.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Random effects models; One-way and two-way random effects; Mixed effects models; ANOVA using R.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Fixed vs random effects models; Implementation in R; Model comparison and interpretation.
